bm_cook.text: Fish chowder, Bermuda style: fish, tomato, onion, thyme, black rum, sherry peppers. It's meant to be so thick a spoon stands up in it.
Everybody on this island has a grandmother's recipe. Every grandmother's recipe is the real one.

bm_diner.text: Bermuda fish sandwich: fried fish, tartare sauce, between two slices of raisin bread. I know. Don't knock it. You're not in a position to.
If you ask for it with chips you'll be given them in a way that makes you feel as if you've asked for something else.
